basics.name: David (Jiachen) Weng
basics.label: Product Engineer & Creative Technologist
basics.summary: Product engineer and creative technologist in Vancouver. I build things that look good and work well, from brand identities to open-source apps. I maintain projects across stacks (Tauri + Rust, Go, Rust + egui) with a local-first, agent-friendly design philosophy. My work spans product strategy, full-stack development, AI-integrated workflows, and visual design. Co-Founder of OwO Network, LLC.
